Timescale (rebranded TigerData in January 2026) offers managed PostgreSQL with time-series extensions. The SLA document exists but meaningful credit remedy is restricted to Enterprise plan customers — for non-Enterprise customers, credits are explicitly at the vendor's "sole discretion" with no obligation. Contact Timescale/TigerData directly for Enterprise SLA terms.
